title: Greetings in the Afternoon
subject: English Language
objectives: Greet someone politely in the afternoon
Have a short conversation with a friend

blocks.md: In the afternoon, we say **"Good afternoon"**. When we leave, we say **"See you after school"** or **"See you tomorrow"**.

blocks.alt: Two pupils greeting each other in the afternoon
blocks.caption: Ayo and Emeka greet each other after class.

lines.speaker: Ayo
lines.text: Emeka, good afternoon. How are you?

lines.speaker: Emeka
lines.text: Good afternoon, Ayo. I am fine. Have you done your homework?

lines.speaker: Ayo
lines.text: Yes. Is your brother well now?

lines.speaker: Ayo
lines.text: Jibril was looking for you during the break.

lines.speaker: Emeka
lines.text: I saw him. He wanted his homework book.

lines.speaker: Ayo
lines.text: Did he want to help Aisha?

lines.speaker: Emeka
lines.text: Perhaps. That is kind of him.

lines.speaker: Emeka
lines.text: Yes, it is. We should go inside now.

blocks.md: **Remember:** In the afternoon we say **'Good afternoon'** — not **'Good morning'**. Save that for the start of the day!

quiz.q: What greeting do you use in the afternoon?
How does Ayo say goodbye to Emeka?
quiz.explain: Ayo says 'See you after school' to say goodbye politely.

quiz.q: Aisha is a girl. Which is correct?
